gui.stagelite.cabeza_movil.pattern.toolt: How the beam moves: fixed (doesn't move), sweep (side to side) or circle.
gui.stagelite.consola.group.tooltip: Apply the changes to every spotlight in this group.
gui.stagelite.consola.apply.tooltip: Changes the color, intensity and effect of every spotlight in the chosen group.
gui.stagelite.consola.blackout.tooltip: Turns every known spotlight off (or back on), without touching its configuration.
gui.stagelite.consola.strobe.tooltip: Sets blink on every known spotlight, keeping its current color and intensity.
gui.stagelite.consola.no_groups: No groups yet: give a spotlight a group name from its own screen.
gui.stagelite.consola.speed.tooltip: The BPM/speed for Blink, Breathe, Rainbow and Chase.
gui.stagelite.consola.scene.name: Scene name
gui.stagelite.consola.scene.save.tooltip: Saves the current color/intensity/effect/speed of the chosen group as a scene with this name.
gui.stagelite.consola.scene.load.tooltip: Applies this saved scene to its group right now.
gui.stagelite.consola.no_scenes: No scenes saved yet: pick a group and a look in the Groups tab, name it here and press Save scene.
gui.stagelite.consola.show.name: Show name
gui.stagelite.consola.show.save.tooltip: Saves these 4 steps as a show with this name.
gui.stagelite.consola.show.play.tooltip: Plays the chosen show and arms it for the next redstone signal.
gui.stagelite.consola.show.stop.tooltip: Stops the show currently playing on this console.
gui.stagelite.consola.show.step.scene.to: This step's scene. Click to change it.
gui.stagelite.consola.show.step.duration: How long this step lasts. Click to change the duration.
gui.stagelite.consola.show.step.transiti: Cut (instant change) or Fade (fades in from the previous step over the whole duration). Click to change.
gui.stagelite.foco.intensity.tooltip: How bright the spotlight looks once it has power.
gui.stagelite.foco.group.tooltip: Give it a name (e.g. 'Stage') so a future console can control it along with others in the same group.
